bakta_db.help_text: Path to the Bakta database. If doesn't exist under given path, the 'light' database will be automatically downloaded

bakta_db_type.help_text: Type of Bakta database to be downloaded. Note that pseudogene detection happens only with the 'full' database [light|full]

user_proteins.help_text: User-provided expert proteins in FASTA format for CDS annotation

user_hmms.help_text: User-provided hidden markov model in HMMER format for CDS annotation

auxiliary_db.help_text: Pangenome index: a .sqlite file, a legacy JSON/pickle file, or a hosted lookup URL (https://host/v1/<species>/<version>). An existing index supplies protein annotations. A local path is created or extended when missing or when --extend_auxdb is set.

extend_auxdb.help_text: Add CDS annotations to an existing local pangenome index. Hosted URLs are not modified.

pangenome_similarity.help_text: For proteins missing from the exact-hash index, search representative sequences when that index defines a similarity threshold.

monochrome_logs.help_text: Should logs appear in plain ASCII
